description: Project scaffolding and full backend API. Creates the monorepo root, installs all dependencies, builds the complete Express server with all 7 Mongoose models, all 6 route+controller sets (auth, schemes, campaigns, donations, admin, enquiries), all utility functions (PDF generator, receipt counter, eligibility engine, email service), and the seed script. After this FEAT the backend is fully functional and the seed data is loaded.
steps: Create empowerher/ root: package.json with dev script using concurrently, .gitignore (node_modules, dist, .env, *.pdf, server/uploads/). Install root dep: concurrently@8.2.2.

Scaffold server/: run `npm init -y` in server/, install exact deps: express@4.18.3 mongoose@8.4.0 bcryptjs@2.4.3 jsonwebtoken@9.0.2 joi@17.13.1 razorpay@2.9.2 pdfkit@0.15.0 nodemailer@6.9.13 multer@1.4.5-lts.1 cloudinary@2.2.0 express-rate-limit@7.3.1 cors@2.8.5 dotenv@16.4.5. Dev dep: nodemon@3.1.3. Add scripts: dev=nodemon src/server.js, start=node src/server.js, seed=node src/seed.js. Create server/.env.example with all vars from plan.md item 39.
Create server/src/config/db.js: mongoose.connect(process.env.MONGODB_URI) with useNewUrlParser + useUnifiedTopology. Export connectDB().

Create server/src/models/Counter.js: { _id: String, seq: Number default 0 }. Create server/src/utils/receiptCounter.js: export getNextReceiptNumber() using findOneAndUpdate $inc on { _id: 'receipt' }, format as RCP-YYYY-000001. THIS IS THE ONLY PLACE receipt numbers are generated.

Create server/src/models/User.js: fields name, email(unique), passwordHash, role(enum donor|admin), pan(regex /^[A-Z]{5}[0-9]{4}[A-Z]$/), phone, address, createdAt. Instance method comparePassword(). Pre-save hook hashes password. Add DPDP comment on PAN and address fields.
Create server/src/models/Scheme.js: all fields from plan.md item 6. Index on need+state+status. Hindi fields (_hi) must NOT have ASCII validators.
Create server/src/models/Campaign.js: title, description, targetAmount(paise), raisedAmount(paise, default 0), image, status(enum active|closed), startDate, endDate.
Create server/src/models/Donation.js: all fields from plan.md item 8. DPDP comment on PAN, email, phone. receiptNumber has unique+sparse index.
Create server/src/models/Bookmark.js, Enquiry.js, AdminLog.js: fields from plan.md item 9. Bookmark has compound unique index { userId, schemeId }.

Create server/src/utils/eligibilityEngine.js: pure function matchSchemes(answers, schemes). answers shape: { maritalStatus, age, bplCard, pregnant, shmMember, district }. Evaluates eligibilityCriteria array (operators: eq|gte|lte|includes|bool). AND logic — all criteria must pass. Returns matched schemes with matchLabel: 'संभावित मिलान'. No DB calls inside.

Create server/src/utils/pdfGenerator.js: uses pdfkit. generateReceiptPDF(donation, campaign) returns Buffer. Reads TRUST_NAME, TRUST_PAN, TRUST_80G_REG from env — throws clear Error if any missing. Layout: trust header, receipt no+date, donor name+PAN, amount in ₹ and words (amountToWords helper — English words), campaign name, TEST/SANDBOX footer. The TEST footer is ALWAYS present — never gated.

Create server/src/utils/emailService.js: sendDonationConfirmation({ to, donorName, receiptNumber, amount, campaignName, pdfBuffer }). Dev: Ethereal transport — log getTestMessageUrl to console. Wraps in try/catch — never throws to caller.
Create server/src/middleware/auth.js: protect (verify JWT Bearer, attach req.user={id,role}), adminOnly (check role==='admin', else 403 { success:false, error:'Forbidden' }).
Create server/src/middleware/rateLimiter.js: authLimiter (10 req/15min), schemesLimiter (100 req/1min) using express-rate-limit@7.
Create server/src/middleware/errorHandler.js: 4-arg Express error handler, logs error, responds { success:false, error: err.message } with err.status||500.

Create server/src/middleware/upload.js: multer memoryStorage(). Export uploadToCloudinary(buffer, folder) that calls cloudinary.uploader.upload_stream returning secure URL. If CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME env is absent, save buffer to server/uploads/ and return local path.

Create server/src/controllers/authController.js + server/src/routes/authRoutes.js: POST /api/auth/register (Joi validation, bcrypt hash, return token+user), POST /api/auth/login (authLimiter, comparePassword, sign JWT 7d), GET /api/auth/me (protect). All errors use { success:false, error }.

Create server/src/controllers/schemeController.js + server/src/routes/schemeRoutes.js. IMPORTANT route order: mount /bookmarks and /eligibility BEFORE /:id. GET /api/schemes (schemesLimiter, text search, filters, pagination), GET /api/schemes/:id, POST /api/schemes/eligibility (load all published schemes, call matchSchemes), POST /api/schemes/:id/bookmark (protect, upsert Bookmark), GET /api/schemes/bookmarks (protect, populate).
Create server/src/controllers/campaignController.js + server/src/routes/campaignRoutes.js: GET /api/campaigns (active only), GET /api/campaigns/:id.

Create server/src/controllers/donationController.js + server/src/routes/donationRoutes.js: POST /api/donations/create-order (validate body including acceptedPrivacyPolicy:true, create Razorpay order, save Donation pending), POST /api/donations/verify (backend-only signature verification using crypto.createHmac, getNextReceiptNumber, generateReceiptPDF, update Donation+Campaign, send email, detect international:true and return 400 with Hindi message), GET /api/donations/my (protect), GET /api/donations/:id/receipt (protect, ownership check, stream PDF).

Create server/src/controllers/adminController.js + server/src/routes/adminRoutes.js. All routes: protect+adminOnly. Helper logAdminAction() saves AdminLog. Routes: GET /api/admin/dashboard (aggregate stats), GET+POST+PUT+DELETE /api/admin/schemes (DELETE = soft-delete to draft, POST sets mock aiDraft_hi and aiDraftApproved:false), POST /api/admin/schemes/:id/approve-draft, GET+POST+PUT /api/admin/campaigns (POST uses multer+cloudinary upload), GET /api/admin/donations (filters+pagination), GET /api/admin/donations/export-csv (Mongoose cursor, stream CSV), GET /api/admin/donations/form10bd (stream CSV with EXACT columns: Sl. No.,Name of Donor,Address,PAN/Aadhaar,Amount,Mode of Receipt,Nature of Receipt,Date), GET /api/admin/logs.
Create server/src/routes/enquiryRoutes.js: POST /api/enquiries (no auth required, save Enquiry, return saved doc id).
Create server/src/server.js: load dotenv, connectDB(), apply CORS (origin from CLIENT_URL), express.json(), mount all routers at correct paths, mount errorHandler last.

Create server/src/seed.js: idempotent (findOneAndUpdate upsert). Seeds: 2 users (admin@empowerher.org/Admin@123 role:admin, donor@test.com/Donor@123 role:donor), 3 schemes (SCH-014 widow pension, SCH-022 SHG loan, SCH-031 maternity — full Hindi+English fields from plan.md item 38), 2 campaigns (वार्षिक स्वास्थ्य शिविर 2026, बालिका शिक्षा अभियान — amounts in paise). Log 'Seed complete'.
acceptance_criteria: npm run dev from server/ starts without import errors and connects to MongoDB
POST /api/auth/login with admin@empowerher.org/Admin@123 returns token after seed
GET /api/schemes returns array of published schemes after seed
POST /api/schemes/eligibility with widowed+BPL answers returns SCH-014
GET /api/admin/dashboard with admin JWT returns stats object
GET /api/admin/dashboard with donor JWT returns HTTP 403
node src/seed.js completes without error and idempotently re-runs
server/.env.example exists with all required variable names
FEAT status updated to completed in FEAT-001.json
verification: cd server && node src/server.js — server starts on port 5000 without errors (requires MongoDB)
cd server && npm run seed — prints 'Seed complete'
curl -X POST http://localhost:5000/api/auth/login -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"email":"admin@empowerher.org","password":"Admin@123"}' — returns JSON with token
curl http://localhost:5000/api/schemes — returns array with 3 schemes

curl -X POST http://localhost:5000/api/schemes/eligibility -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"answers":{"maritalStatus":"widowed","age":45,"bplCard":true,"pregnant":false,"shmMember":false,"district":"Bhopal"}}' — returns array containing the widow pension scheme
findings: 1. MongoDB was not running locally during implementation; all module imports and syntax were verified without a live DB. The seed script and curl verifications require MongoDB to be started before running. 2. The seed script bypasses the User model pre-save hash hook (uses bcrypt directly) because findOneAndUpdate does not trigger pre-save hooks — this is intentional and correct. 3. The server/.env file was created for local dev convenience but is gitignored per plan. 4. The Razorpay international-payment check uses razorpay.payments.fetch() which is non-fatal — if it fails (e.g. test key restrictions), the payment still proceeds. 5. mongoose@8.4.0 deprecated useNewUrlParser/useUnifiedTopology options; they are kept for forward-compatibility comment but have no runtime effect. 6. All cross-cutting constraints enforced: money in paise, receipt numbers only via getNextReceiptNumber(), Razorpay signature verified server-side only, TEST footer always in PDF, API responses always {success,data/error}, /bookmarks and /eligibility routes mounted before /:id, Hindi _hi fields have no ASCII validators, DPDP comments on every PAN/email/phone field, adminOnly returns 403 for non-admin.
